statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder reports their card was stolen [1 day before this transaction]. A $156.78 grocery purchase at 'FRESHMART SUPERMARKET' was made the next day. The cardholder did not make this purchase and reported the card as stolen to the bank.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: N/A — card was stolen; cardholder did not visit the store.
statement.requestedResolution: Reversal of the $156.78 charge made on the stolen card.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Medium — merchant may have valid defense documentation.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4871 (Chip/PIN Liability Shift — Lost/Stolen/NRI).
